_howToLabel: One entry per notice in permits.json. Fill in the null fields; do not edit id, layer, text, candidateDates or tyoPaattyy.
severity (outdoor events, traffic arrangements): info | minor | consider | major
mainlyAffected (all layers): drivers | cyclists | pedestrians | transit | parking | everyone | nobody | unknown
mainlyAffected may be a list when several groups are equally affected; Jev's single answer counts as correct if it is any of them.
workType (digs): water_sewer | district_heating | electricity_telecom | paving | street_construction | building_site | other
endDate (digs): one of candidateDates, or "not_stated". tyoPaattyy is the city's field value, shown for reference only.
candidateDates are the dates the Classifier offers Jev (from candidateDates() in questions.ts): d.m.yyyy, 'd.m. yyyy' and ISO dates; a date without a year takes the year of the next full date.
Leave null when you think the Classifier shouldn't be confident (below the threshold); only filled answers are checked.
